reason: E1 shows that thermal exposure of a similar HEA coating in air forms Cr2O3 and mixed oxides that enhance wear resistance, supporting the first two premises. However, neither E1 nor E2 provides evidence that the oxide is nanocrystalline, adherent, or forms uniformly, nor do they demonstrate the barrier mechanism under the specified wear conditions. E2 only confirms oxide presence on a worn surface without linking it to pre-formed layers or the proposed mechanism.
premises: Thermal exposure of FeNiCrCoCu-based coatings in air forms a protective oxide layer containing Cr2O3 and mixed spinel oxides
This oxide layer enhances wear resistance
The oxide layer is adherent and nanocrystalline
The oxide layer acts as a barrier reducing direct metal contact and abrasive wear
The oxide layer forms uniformly on the coating surface
